verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable search engine, so the axis applies, but the pack contains no documented opt-out mechanism. The only telemetry-related item is a community report that analytics is on by default (a daily ping with a unique identifier), which describes the tracking but not a way to disable it. The documented analytics feature (docs-9) is customer-facing search analytics, a different feature, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
